title: Short walk ideas
intro: Wherever you go, a few steps will do. Pick whatever sounds nice.

prompts.text: Walk to the end of the street and back.
Take the long way to the nearest door.
Walk a slow lap of the building, indoors or out.
Choose a colour and look for it as you walk.
Walk at a relaxed pace and let your arms swing.
Go up or down one flight of stairs, then come back.
Pause somewhere with a view and take it in.
Walk and listen: how many different sounds can you hear?
Stroll to somewhere green, even if it is only a single plant.
Walk without your phone, just for a few minutes.
Take a few steps outside to feel the air on your face.
Find a spot in the sun or in the shade, whichever you prefer.

backAtDesk: Welcome back. Your walk is yours to keep.
